APPLY AFTER al6: al7 is the SEVENTH region of the aeneis track and must
follow al1..al6 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js regionIndex()
reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE difficulty
input (DESIGN §6).
al7 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al7) with TWO phases:
ordina (hp 6 / 45 s) + sententia (hp 5 / 55 s) — the al2/al5 shape,
because this is an ōrdina liber like those two and the three should tune
alike. Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 11 / 100 s.
bossMinMs 15000 matches l2/l3/al1..al6.
The ordina phase declares its categories in the content file and does NOT
declare `items`: js/probatio.js then draws from the liber's whole
vocabulary and drops every word no category claims (zoneOf), so exactly
eight words can fall (mēnsa, seges, pastor, mānsuētus / Turnus, Camilla,
exercitus, Alēctō). Tiberis, Latium, cōnsūmit, Latīnus, Lāvīnia, lūcus and
aperit are unclaimed ON PURPOSE — a rēx who refuses the war and a gate
that opens it belong to neither pile. Nothing for rules.php to know;
recorded so the integrator does not go looking for an item list.
The sententia phase declares its own `items` (6, hand-authored). All 6
survive js/boss-phases.js fromAuthored() with zero warnings — verified
against the real gate, not a stub.
